description: Publication-grade scientific figures and tables with evidence fidelity, adaptive layout, and rendered-output QA.

defaultPrompt: Create a publication-ready benchmark figure and exact-value table from these results.
Plot score versus cost and latency, compute the Pareto frontier, and inspect the final-size render.
Audit these research figures and fix hierarchy, density, labels, clipping, and consistency.
interface.longDescription: Create and quality-assure scientific, quantitative, statistical, benchmark, and data-analysis figures and tables. The skill preserves supplied evidence, selects visual forms using deterministic rules, applies restrained publication-grade hierarchy and typography, adapts layouts to labels and density, and inspects the actual final-size render before delivery. It supports comparison charts, uncertainty plots, distributions, calibration, ablations, Pareto frontiers, time series, analytical diagrams, and research-result tables. Explicit generative-image, illustration, artwork, and photorealistic-image requests remain outside this workflow unless the user asks to combine them.

name: scientific-visual-table-style
